title: Ads in AI Chatbots? An Analysis of How Large Language Models Navigate Conflicts of Interest

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with user personas that implicitly or explicitly convey varying socio-economic statuses (SES) through occupations, life circumstances, or yearly income, and measuring the difference in rates at which the models recommend expensive sponsored products versus cheaper non-sponsored products to high-SES versus low-SES users.
